title: OpportunityCandidate
description: One candidate commercial-opportunity, produced by the V3.2 deterministic scan (scripts/run_deterministic_scan.py) or confirmed/added by a specialist (scripts/route_to_specialist.py). Multiple candidates may exist per prospect; exactly one is ever promoted to primary_wedge (schemas/primary_wedge.schema.json) via scripts/wedge_selection.py. A candidate is never created merely because a check failed -- it must have a real commercial-relevance rationale.

statement.description: One sentence, specific, checkable -- not a generic category description

commercial_relevance.description: Would a real owner care about this, independent of how technically severe it is

specificity.description: How prospect-specific this observation is -- see the company-swap test, scripts/wedge_selection.py

actionability.description: How clear and concrete a free first action is for this opportunity -- feeds wedge scoring's actionability component

requires_specialist.description: true if this candidate needs interpretive judgment beyond what the deterministic scan itself can conclude
